name: browser-control
description: Drive a real Chromium-based browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: connect, inspect, evaluate, navigate, screenshot, and poll events, as a CLI, an MCP server, or a shared daemon.

scripts.build:skill: mkdir -p .agents/skills/browser-control/runtime/src && bun build cli.ts --target bun --minify --outfile .agents/skills/browser-control/runtime/cli.js && bun build mcp.ts --target bun --minify --outfile .agents/skills/browser-control/runtime/mcp.js && cp capability.json README.md .agents/skills/browser-control/runtime/ && cp -R src/. .agents/skills/browser-control/runtime/src/
